EC1: signs of complicated UTI (e. g. temperature [OR] > 38°C, loin tenderness)
EC2: conditions  [AND]that may lead to complicated infections (i.e. renal diseases, [OR] patients  [AND]with urinary catheter)
EC4: current self-medication with UU preparations e.g. z.B. Cystinol®, U [OR]valysat®, A [OR]rctuvan®
EC5: antibiotic use in the last 7 days
EC6: previous UTI in the past 2 weeks
EC11: current participation in another clinical trial or participation in another clinical trial within the last 4 weeks
